content:
As of **June 2024**, the estimated population of the **United States** is approximately **335 million** people.

For the most precise and up-to-date figure, you can refer to:
- **U.S. Census Bureau** ([www.census.gov](https://www.census.gov)) – Their latest estimate is around **334.9 million** (as of mid-2024).
- **Worldometer** ([www.worldometers.info](https://www.worldometers.info/world-population/us-population/)) – Provides real-time estimates.

Would you like historical trends or state-by-state breakdowns?
